$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-095 D5 — the club labels the fitzRoy ladder witness emits, and when. MEASURED by the exhaustive read-only probe of fetch_ladder_afltables across every completed season 1897-2025 (run 2026-08-28): 129/129 seasons, 1,622 club-season rows, 20 distinct labels. Stored compactly as span plus explicit gaps so the exact 1,622 (label, season) pairs regenerate deterministically and every gap is a reviewed statement rather than an accident. This is a SOURCE contract, not club identity: the labels are modernised, one per organization, and only ClubResolver plus source_club_normalisation turn them into AFLDB's time-bounded identities.
gap_note: Every gap below is a genuine wartime withdrawal, not a source failure. 1916 the competition ran with four clubs only (Carlton, Collingwood, Fitzroy, Richmond); 1917 with six and 1918 with seven; Geelong stood down in 1942-1943. A club that did not play has NO ladder row and must have NO club_seasons row — absence, never a zero row.

modernised_labels.$comment: The four families where the emitted label is NOT the identity that traded that season. Proven from the probe, in both directions. 'Kangaroos' is never emitted at all.
modernised_labels.Sydney: emitted back to 1897; South Melbourne traded 1897-1981
modernised_labels.Footscray: emitted forward to 2025; Western Bulldogs has traded since 1997
modernised_labels.Brisbane Lions: emitted back to 1987; Brisbane Bears traded 1987-1996
modernised_labels.North Melbourne: emitted across 1999-2007, when the club traded as the Kangaroos
